ruleDefinitions.name: Ie4uinit Lolbin Use From Invalid Path
ruleDefinitions.description: Detect use of ie4uinit.exe to execute commands from a specially prepared ie4uinit.inf file from a directory other than the usual directories

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\\\ie4uinit\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "IE4UINIT\.EXE") AND  NOT ((process_working_directory = "c\:\\windows\\system32\\" OR process_working_directory = "c\:\\windows\\sysWOW64\\") OR process_working_directory = "None")
